subject: Lumera Diagnostics — request for one-time hosted API rate concession
messages:
From: Emily Kwan <emily.kwan@lumeradiag.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-10-10T08:12:00Z
Subject: Hosted API pricing — request for volume concession

Hi Chloe —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Lumera is very interested in piloting Redwood's Hosted API for our clinical inference pipeline. We ran a quick forecast and the expected token volume for our initial 18-month rollout is higher than we anticipated (attached).

Our procurement team has asked whether Redwood can provide a one-time concession on the per-token hosted usage rate for the first 12 months — specifically a 30% discount off list rates — in exchange for a signed 24-month commitment and a mutual public case study. The financial ask is significant but this customer is strategic for us in diagnostics and could unlock introductions to two health system partners.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can support this level of discount and what approvals are required? If helpful, procurement will send a standard SOW with volume buckets and payment terms.

Thanks,
Emily Kwan
Head of Platform & Integrations
Lumera Diagnostics

Attachments: Lumera_usage_forecast_Q4.xlsx
From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Kwan <emily.kwan@lumeradiag.com>
Date: 2029-10-10T10:03:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API pricing — Lumera asks for 30% concession (need exec sanction)

Team — forwarding Lumera's ask. Summary and recommendation below:

Summary:
- External ask: 30% off Hosted API list per-token rates for first 12 months; 24-month contract; committed usage ramp in SOW.
- ARR / economics: their forecast suggests ~$1.2M ARR run-rate in year 2; up-front year 1 usage monetizes ~ $650k at list before concession.
- Strategic value: high — potential introductions to enterprise health systems and co-marketing opportunity.

Recommendation (commercial): Approve a 25% one-time concession for the first 12 months contingent on:
  - A signed 24-month commitment with minimum annual spend floors (documented in SOW).
  - Public case study approval clause.
  - Prepayment of first quarter or standard net-30 with an early payment credit.

I'm asking Marcus and Stephanie to escalate for senior approval (discount >20%). Attaching the draft SOW and the forecast Lumera sent.

Chloe Martin
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
chloe_martin@redwood.com

Attachments: Lumera_SOW_v3.pdf, Lumera_usage_forecast_Q4.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-10-10T11:17:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API pricing — Lumera asks for 30% concession (need exec sanction)

Chloe —

I agree with the recommendation to cap the concession at 25% with the conditions you listed. A few quick notes to support the ask to leadership:
- Lumera's forecast Q1–Q4 (attached) shows a steep ramp that improves unit economics after month 6; we can absorb a heavier concession early if the contract has clear usage floors and an 18–24 month commit.
- They are asking for enterprise SLA (99.9) and multiregion deployment in us-east + us-west; deployment cost adders should be recovered via a platform fee line item, not through discount.
- Sales request: ability to offer an initial onboarding credit (one-time) and then baseline 25% concession on hosted tokens for months 1–12.

If Marcus/Stef can route this to Mina for final sign-off, I think we have a path.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-10-11T09:02:00Z
Subject: Exec ask — Lumera Diagnostics concession (requesting >20% approval)

Mina —

Putting a formal ask on your desk for Lumera. Request: approval of a one-time hosted-usage concession of up to 25% (Lumera asked 30%). Rationale and mitigation: 

1) Revenue upside: With a 24-month commit and the usage floors we negotiated into SOW v3, expected committed ARR is ~$1.35M. We model the net present value of the concession at ~ $120k over the first 12 months vs. list.
2) Strategic upside: Lumera is positioned to pilot with two potential health system partners that have voiced interest pending vendor selection. Co-marketing/case study expected to accelerate sales in diagnostics vertical.
3) Controls: Approval should be conditional on (a) minimum annual spend floors in SOW, (b) explicit case study clause & customer marketing opt-in, (c) platform fee for multiregion SLA adders to preserve margin, and (d) no retroactive extension of the concession beyond the first 12 months without Exec re-approval.

Requested: sign-off for up to 25% concession and delegated authority to sales ops to apply the concession in the commercial terms. If you prefer a narrower concession (20%) we will push for tighter floors and an expanded platform fee.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
VP, Sales — Enterprise
marcus_lin@redwood.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-10-11T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Exec ask — Lumera Diagnostics concession (requesting >20% approval)

Thanks for the concise P&R, Marcus. I approve a one-time 25% concession on Hosted API per-token rates for the first 12 months under the following non-negotiable conditions: 

1) Signed 24-month MSA + SOW v3 with the minimum annual spend floors documented and a termination-for-cause clause tied to usage floors.
2) Lumera must approve and sign the public case study and provide a senior customer reference within 6 months of go-live.
3) All multiregion deployment & premium SLA costs are listed as a separate platform fee (not part of the discount base).
4) Finance to run final NPV and add a clawback clause for material underdelivery vs. forecast; SalesOps to lock the concession in contract and prohibit stacking with other promotional credits.

Sales: proceed to finalize SOW with Lumera and route the finalized contract to Legal and Finance for the clawback language. If Lumera will not agree to the case study or the floors, the concession stands at 15% max.

Mina Haddad
Chief Revenue Officer, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
